description: A fundamental hip throw where you load your opponent onto your hip and rotate them to the ground.
A major outer reaping throw. You reap your opponent's leg from the outside while breaking their balance backward.
A shoulder throw where you load your opponent onto your back and throw them forward over your shoulder.
Scarf hold. A fundamental pinning technique where you control your opponent by holding their head and arm while seated beside them.
Side four-quarter hold. You control your opponent from the side, securing both their hips and head.
Cross armlock. You hyperextend your opponent's elbow joint by placing their arm across your hips while lying perpendicular to them.
